proof_scope: /ask fix-issues: the diagnose->verify->close ticket flow. A real GitHub issue is gathered via gh, diagnosed through a live /ask one-shot handler into a structured cause/fix/needs_debugger/verify JSON (the debugger ladder gate: /debugger is recommended only when the diagnosis names in-process runtime state no artifact explains), and closing is fail-closed: dry-run by default, and even with --execute an issue is never closed without its verify command actually passing. Capability-gated on gh auth and the answer handler.

claims.proves: fix-issues gathers a real open issue and produces a structured diagnosis via a live handler (dry-run exit 0, plan printed); with --execute and no verify command it refuses to close (blocked, exit 1); with --execute and a failing verify command it reports verify-failed (exit 1) and does not close; and a gh failure surfaces as a named error, not a silent pass
claims.does_not_prove: diagnosis correctness for arbitrary issues, or the closed-issue happy path (closing a real issue is a destructive external write and is exercised only under human direction)

cases.name: dry-run-diagnoses-real-issue
cases.description: Dry-run against a real open issue produces a structured diagnosis (cause + ladder gate + verify plan) and exits 0 without touching the issue.
command: set -uo pipefail; cd .. && timeout 280 bash run.sh fix-issues --repo grahama1970/agent-skills --issue 1441

cases.name: execute-without-verify-refuses-to-close
cases.description: --execute with a diagnosis that names no verify command refuses to close (blocked) instead of closing on an unproven fix. Uses --verify-cmd '' to force the no-verify path deterministically.
command: set -uo pipefail; cd .. && timeout 280 bash run.sh fix-issues --repo grahama1970/agent-skills --issue 1441 --execute --verify-cmd '' ; rc=$?; [ $rc -eq 1 ] && exit 0 || { echo "UNEXPECTED-RC=$rc"; exit 1; }

cases.name: execute-with-failing-verify-does-not-close
cases.description: --execute with a verify command that fails reports verify-failed and does not close the issue.
command: set -uo pipefail; cd .. && timeout 280 bash run.sh fix-issues --repo grahama1970/agent-skills --issue 1441 --execute --verify-cmd 'false'; rc=$?; state=$(gh issue view 1441 --repo grahama1970/agent-skills --json state --jq .state); echo "STATE-AFTER=$state"; [ $rc -eq 1 ] && [ "$state" = "OPEN" ] && exit 0 || { echo "UNEXPECTED rc=$rc state=$state"; exit 1; }

cases.name: bad-repo-fails-closed
cases.description: A nonexistent repo surfaces as a named error (exit 1), never a silent pass.
command: set -uo pipefail; cd .. && bash run.sh fix-issues --repo grahama1970/does-not-exist-xyz --issue 1; rc=$?; [ $rc -eq 1 ] && exit 0 || { echo "UNEXPECTED-RC=$rc"; exit 1; }
